2608.18921.title: SMTrap: Cost-Effective DoS Attacks Against Large Reasoning Models via SMT Conflict Guidance
2608.18921.paper_summary: Existing LRM-DoS methods rely heavily on model feedback to synthesize attack queries, requiring either repeated queries to the target model or training a dedicated attack model. These expensive operations severely weaken attack leverage. In this paper, we propose \emph{search amplification}, a novel, model-feedback-free LRM-DoS paradigm. It employs the conflict count derived from an Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) solver as a low-cost external signal to guide the synthesis of inference-heavy Constraint Satisfaction Problem (CSP) instances. Our key observation is that LRMs depend on trial-and-backtracking search when solving CSPs, where higher SMT conflict counts on a given CSP instance positively correlate with more extensive LRM backtracking search and substantially longer output trajectories. Building on this finding, we propose \textsc{SMTrap}, a lightweight, CPU-only framework. Guided by SMT conflict counts, \textsc{SMTrap} generates inference-heavy CSP queries without model queries, attack-model training, or GPU computation. Evaluations across seven frontier models demonstrate the state-of-the-art LRM-DoS capability of \textsc{SMTrap}, producing DoS effects multiple times stronger than existing baselines. To mitigate the threat of \textsc{SMTrap}, we demonstrate a tool-based mitigation that significantly cuts token usage.
2608.18921.paper_summary_zh: 現有的 LRM-DoS 方法在合成攻擊查詢時過度依賴模型反饋，這需要對目標模型進行重複查詢或訓練專門的攻擊模型。這些昂貴的操作嚴重削弱了攻擊的杠杆作用。在本文中，我們提出了 \emph{search amplification}，一種新穎的無模型反饋的 LRM-DoS 範式。它利用從可滿足性模組理論（SMT）求解器派生的衝突計數作為低成本的外部信號，以指導合成推理密集的約束滿足問題（CSP）實例。我們的關鍵觀察是，LRM 在解決 CSP 時依賴於試探和回溯搜索，其中給定 CSP 實例的較高 SMT 衝突計數與更廣泛的 LRM 回溯搜索以及顯著更長的輸出軌跡正相關。基於這一發現，我們提出了 \textsc{SMTrap}，一個輕量級的僅 CPU 的框架。在 SMT 衝突計數的指導下，\textsc{SMTrap} 生成推理密集的 CSP 查詢，而無需模型查詢、攻擊模型訓練或 GPU 計算。對七個前沿模型的評估顯示，\textsc{SMTrap} 的 LRM-DoS 能力達到最先進的水平，產生的 DoS 效果比現有基準強多倍。為了減輕 \textsc{SMTrap} 的威脅，我們展示了一種基於工具的緩解方法，顯著減少了令牌的使用。
